text:
DEPARTMENT OF ROBOTICS & AUTOMATION
METROPOLITAN UNIVERSITY OF COMPUTING
Date: October 24, 2024

To the Graduate Admissions Committee,

I am writing to offer my enthusiastic recommendation for Sneha Rajendra Patel, who I have mentored as Thesis Advisor & Course Instructor during their study period (2020-2024) at Metropolitan University of Computing.

During this tenure, Sneha Rajendra Patel demonstrated exceptional mastery in Natural Language Processing, Transformers, FastAPI, PostgreSQL. In our research laboratory, they led the pivotal development of 'Graph Neural Networks for Large-Scale Knowledge Graph Completion', exhibiting remarkable technical intuition, rigorous experimental discipline, and intellectual maturity. Additionally, the candidate maintained an exemplary academic record with a GPA of 9.4 / 10.0.

Beyond technical competence, Sneha Rajendra Patel displays genuine leadership, integrity, and proactive collaboration. I rank Sneha Rajendra Patel among the top 1% of researchers I have supervised. I strongly recommend them for admission and financial fellowship without reservation.

Warm regards,

Prof. Elena Rostova
Distinguished Professor
Robotics & Automation
Metropolitan University of Computing
Email: prof..elena.rostova@metropolit.edu
